about: 2.42 daily safe copy of live.db and bench.db (live/backup.py): once a day after the close, SQLite online backup, checked, kept for `keep` days. dir: null = data/backups; set an iCloud Drive or external-disk folder to keep a copy off this disk. Token, key and settings files are never copied. 2.92 (Mandeep, 23 Nov 2026, the Mac's disk 91% full: 'Backups: 3 din + compress'): keep 3 days, each copy gzip-compressed (restore: gunzip -k live.db.gz, then put it in data/ while the app is closed).
